title: Automated Temporal Analysis Reveals Stress-Induced Protracted Feeding Regulated by Mesolimbic Dopamine in Mice
description: Source data and a dependency-free one-command reproduction for the temporal feeding analyses. Includes Supplementary Figures S3 and S5: inter-bout interval, bout number, latency and total feeding time. Adjacent bouts separated by gaps shorter than 7 s are merged across consecutive video files; total feeding time includes bridged gaps. This release includes 28 supplementary panel tables with mouse-level source values and recalculates their two-sided, unadjusted statistics. Source values for Figure 3F and Supplementary Figure S2 are held separately and are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request. Figure S4 food-intake data and reviewer-only additional analyses are outside this release.
